input.quote: ARTICLE III OWNERSHIP Licensee acknowledges that Licensor owns all right, title, and interest in and to the Licensed Technology and all Intellectual Property Rights therein.
input.rationale: Article III (p0048) vests all right, title and interest in the Licensed Technology and all Intellectual Property Rights in Licensor, and "Intellectual Property Rights" (p0008) and "Derivative Work" (p0005) are defined so broadly that the bespoke "unique client front end and other enhancements" we commission and pay for under Article VII(b) (p0087) fall on Licensor's side of the line. Our only counter-right is the term-limited, non-exclusive, Field-of-Use licence (p0030), which cannot be modified or sublicensed (p0042, p0047) and which terminates outright on expiry or termination, with all materials returned (p0138). That fails even the fallback, which requires a perpetual, irrevocable, worldwide, royalty-free licence to use, modify and sublicense deliverables. There is also no statement anywhere that we retain our own trade, order and market data. Licensor's ownership of its underlying platform is acceptable, so we have not disturbed it; the inserted paragraph takes the fallback position (licence-back on paid-for Custom Deliverables) plus an express Licensee Data ownership sentence, which is the smallest change proportionate to a platform licence of this kind.

proposal.summary: Add Licensee Data ownership and a perpetual, irrevocable, royalty-free licence back to customisations Licensee pays for
proposal.comment: [Playbook] Article III gives Licensor ownership of everything, including the bespoke front end and customisation work we commission and pay for under Article VII(b), and our only rights terminate with the Agreement. We have added a licence-back on those paid-for deliverables and confirmed that our own trade and order data stays ours; our playbook position is that we own what we pay for, and this fallback leaves Licensor's platform ownership intact.

ops.text: Notwithstanding the foregoing: (i) as between the parties, Licensee owns all right, title and interest in and to all data, orders, trade records and other information submitted, generated or derived by or on behalf of Licensee through the Licensed Technology ("Licensee Data"), together with all of Licensee's pre-existing intellectual property, and nothing in this Agreement assigns or transfers any Licensee Data or any Licensee intellectual property to Licensor; and (ii) with respect to any customization, unique client front end or other development work performed by Licensor specifically for Licensee and paid for by Licensee (including under Article VII(b)) (the "Custom Deliverables"), Licensor hereby grants to Licensee a perpetual, irrevocable, worldwide, royalty-free, fully paid-up license to use, modify and sublicense the Custom Deliverables for Licensee's business purposes, which license shall survive the expiration or termination of this Agreement.
